raw_text: Mumbai Port cyber intrusion is a wake-up call for Indian maritime infrastructure security. A zero-day in a legacy SCADA system gave attackers access to vessel traffic management and cargo scheduling. These systems should never be directly internet-facing. NCIIPC advisory to all ports is crucial but the damage to Mumbai's operations will take days to remediate.
clean_text: Mumbai Port intrusion highlights maritime infrastructure security gaps. Legacy SCADA zero-day enabled access to vessel traffic systems. NCIIPC advisory issued, remediation expected to take days.
